name: Bolinger Band width
description: This keyword returns the width of the Bollinger band of any period of any series of the selected Instrument. This keyword is to be used under the position keyword
how_to_use_markdown:
This keyword returns the width of the Bollinger band of any period of any series of the selected Instrument. This keyword is to be used under the position keyword

![Example](./images/img-1632223339.png)

You can fetch the Bollinger Band width on any series, like close in the above example, you can also plot the same on RSI, OPEN etc
